verification_note: Andhra Pradesh is a fully segregated code path from Telangana. Shared statutory ancestry before state reorganisation does not imply present-day equivalence: rules, slabs, portals and administering authorities diverge and must be read from Andhra Pradesh sources only.

instruments.title: Andhra Pradesh Shops and Establishments Act, 1988
instruments.authority: Labour Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

obligations.summary: Establishments operating in Andhra Pradesh register with the Andhra Pradesh labour department under its own rules and forms.
Hours, holidays and leave entitlements follow Andhra Pradesh rules and are not interchangeable with Telangana's.

instruments.title: Andhra Pradesh Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1987
instruments.authority: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

obligations.summary: Separate Andhra Pradesh professional tax registration is required for workplaces in the state.
Slabs and remittance cycles are notified by the state and must be read from Andhra Pradesh notifications.

instruments.title: Andhra Pradesh Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1987

obligations.summary: Welfare fund contributions are payable to the Andhra Pradesh board on its own cycle.

instruments.title: Andhra Pradesh single-desk industrial clearance framework
instruments.authority: Industries and Commerce Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

obligations.summary: Industrial approvals route through the state's own single-desk system, distinct from Telangana's.

state_escalation_triggers: Copying a Telangana registration pack into an Andhra Pradesh filing — forms, portals and authorities differ.
Assuming a single professional tax enrolment covers workplaces in both states.
